# order: EO:2188  (WPA 1944: 1915 May 4)
# WPA summary: William Leroy Fairbanks made eligiblefor transferfrom chiefclerk of the American Embassy at London, England, to a clerkship in the Commerce Dept. without regard to CivilService Rules. 1915 CSR 124.
# book: Thirty-second Annual Report of the United States Civil Service Commission, fiscal year ended June 30, 1915
# scanned image 131, printed page 124; page lines 49-60
# source: https://archive.org/download/annualreportuni01commgoog/annualreportuni01commgoog_djvu.xml  sha256 92d8549007f776879ba70597db655a8e2deb53a49329d0574b35f0591c6fb041
# found by: monthday_and_names; date 1915-05-04; words leroy|fairbanks|embassy|london|clerkship
# Government printed copy (OCR of a compilation or report), not the signed original. A lead for the
# original_text step: read it against the scan before use. Exact slice of the page OCR follows.
----- EXACT SLICE -----
greatly assist in carrying out the plan of aistribution inaug[uarted by the department.
The Civil Service Commission does not recommend the issuance of an oroer in thia
case.
May 4, 1015.
Mr. William Leroy Fairbanks may be transferred from chief clerk of the American
Embassy at London to a clerkship m the Department of Commerce. He has served
since 1908, at first in the State Department, then in the American Legation at Peking,
and since 1910 in his present position.
The Secretary of Commerce, with the concurrence of the Civil Service Commission,
recommends the issuance of this order in view of the special qualifications of Mr.
Fairbanks for the work of the Bureau of Foreign and Domestic Commerce.
May 11, 1015.
